Name: Abdon, Son of Micah
Summary: Abdon, son of Micah, was one of the men Josiah commanded to enquire of the LORD concerning the found book, and he went to Huldah the prophetess.
KeyStory: The king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam, Abdon the son of Micah, Shaphan and Asaiah to enquire of the LORD.
RelatedPeople: Micah, Father of Abdon; King Josiah
LifeLesson: A king who hears God's word sends men to ask what it means.
